S50U26.five_day_thesis: Against 2026-09-18 the anchor is +7.8 points (1069.4 to 1077.2) but the whole vol structure has drained: ATM IV 13.11% to 10.43% (-2.68) and the 1-sigma day 8.83 to 7.08 points. Max pain has not moved off 1070 once in 8 sessions and the 1100 call wall has not moved either, so the entire 5-day change is in gamma placement, not in the anchor: the flip walked 1100 to 1080 to 1090 as spot climbed through it, and net GEX ran +2,120 to +16,194 before halving to +6,901 today. Positioning rotated puts-ward across the window - put OI +430 to 46,251 while call OI fell 480 to 18,446, P/C OI 2.42 to 2.51 - and the near put wall finally stepped up from 1050 to 1070. The 2026-09-17 session is the live precedent: a 12.7-point drop pushed net GEX to -7,319 with no flip at all, confirming this chain has no dealer support once price leaves the 1070-1090 pocket. With IV compressing rather than expanding into the 6.0-point decline, this is not the max-pain-failure pattern - the option structure is still beating the flow, so the 1070 anchor holds primacy over the 4 remaining sessions.

strategies.name: 1070/1050 put debit spread
strategies.rationale: 1070 is four things at once - 8-session max pain, the 25d put band, the live near put wall (2,389 OI on 777 lots today) and the -4,735 gamma strike - so a close below it hands dealers a short-gamma hedge they must sell into, exactly as on 2026-09-17 when net GEX hit -7,319; buying that break costs 2.4 points because 10.43% IV is an 8-session low, and the short 1050 leg sits where 513 puts traded at 15.4% IV.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 2.4-point net debit, realised at any settlement at or above 1070; max value 20 points at or below 1050, so 7.3:1 on the 20-point width.
strategies.invalidation: A reclaim of 1080, the +4,996 dealer-long-gamma strike - above it dealers dampen and the spread decays with 4 sessions of theta.

strategies.name: 1080/1090 call credit spread
strategies.rationale: The short strike sits on the +4,996 gamma peak where 734 calls traded today and the long strike sits on the 1090 flip itself, so the loss zone begins precisely where dealer hedging turns mean-reverting against continuation; the 14.2-point 4-session cone tops out at 1091.4, leaving the 1082.4 breakeven inside one sigma of the remaining life.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 10-point width - 2.4-point credit = 7.6 points, realised at or above 1090; breakeven 1082.4.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1090, the gamma flip - beyond it the structure is at max loss and the pin thesis is void.

S50U26.prediction: 1063-1091 is the 4-session 1-sigma cone off 7.08-point daily vol, and the centre of gravity is 1070: max pain unmoved for 8 sessions, the near put wall now stacked on it, and the 1090 flip capping the upside. A close above 1090 flips dealers to dampening and voids the downside lean; a close below 1060 puts spot under the whole put-gamma stack (1,876 at 1050, 2,688 at 1000) where hedging amplifies instead of absorbing.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery to force dealer unwinds into expiry: treat every max-pain or wall magnet here as a tendency, not a guarantee, and structurally weaker than the pin seen in physically-settled single stocks. Short-vol structures are specifically poorly paid here: at 10.43% IV a 1060/1090 iron condor with 10-point wings collects about 1.3 points against 8.7 points of max loss, and the negative-skew payoff of selling a compressed vol surface is the documented failure mode.
